name: @nolit/dsh-opencode-v2
description: OpenCode Go pure LLM adapter for DeepSeek Harness: an `opencode` delegation tool, /opencode command and cli_worker, plus an `opencode-http-agent` route that calls the OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions backend directly (streaming text/reasoning/tool deltas, disjoint usage, cached credentials) while the local OpenCode server is used only as a catalog/provider/credential control plane. No agent loop, persona, session prompt, or static cwd.
